context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for this bug is in test_iter29_ticket_status_sync_kanban.py and currently green. UI E2E remains pending due to CAPTCHA failure in browser automation; start by stabilizing login automation, then execute desktop/tablet/mobile drag checks and ticket-list summary sync assertions.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: browser automation login using math captcha fields intermittently returns 400 CAPTCHA invalid, preventing authenticated UI Kanban access. API-based login in pytest succeeds consistently with same credentials and captcha-solving logic, indicating a UI-session/timing-specific issue (captcha lifecycle/state invalidation between render and submit) rather than credential failure. Mitigation: add deterministic login readiness waits per auth_testing.md and validate captcha id/answer pair right before submit; if still failing, inspect frontend login request payload and backend login_attempt/captcha collections during the same UI run.
